notes: Windows 2.0.0-beta.13. Mac download stays 2.0.0-beta.10
DXF import splits a drawing with several closed plates into separate pieces, each with its own icon. Holes stay on the plate.

Cutting-speed table (Listino e parametri): nozzle, gas, and pressure on each material and thickness. Piece detail fills them when that material and thickness is chosen, and they stay editable on the piece.
